mapper.select: SELECT TASK_NO , PRJ_NO , USER_ID , SECT_NO , CREATOR_ID , TASK_NAME , TASK_STATUS , DETAIL_CONTENT , START_DATE , DUE_DATE , PRIORITY_CODE , UPPER_TASK_NO , PROGRESS_RATE , DELETE_DATE , DELETE_USER_ID FROM PRJ_TASK

SELECT TASK_NO , PRJ_NO , USER_ID , SECT_NO , CREATOR_ID , TASK_NAME , TASK_STATUS , DETAIL_CONTENT , START_DATE , DUE_DATE , PRIORITY_CODE , UPPER_TASK_NO , PROGRESS_RATE , DELETE_DATE , DELETE_USER_ID FROM PRJ_TASK WHERE TASK_NO = #{taskNo}

SELECT T.TASK_NO, T.PRJ_NO, T.USER_ID, T.SECT_NO, T.CREATOR_ID, T.TASK_NAME, T.TASK_STATUS, T.DETAIL_CONTENT, T.START_DATE, T.DUE_DATE, T.PRIORITY_CODE, T.UPPER_TASK_NO, T.PROGRESS_RATE, T.DELETE_DATE, T.DELETE_USER_ID FROM PRJ_TASK T
WHERE T.TASK_NO = #{taskNo}
mapper.update: UPDATE PRJ_TASK SET TASK_NAME = #{taskName}, TASK_STATUS = #{taskStatus}, DETAIL_CONTENT = #{detailContent}, START_DATE = #{startDate}, DUE_DATE = #{dueDate}, PRIORITY_CODE = #{priorityCode}, UPPER_TASK_NO = #{upperTaskNo}, PROGRESS_RATE = #{progressRate} WHERE TASK_NO = #{taskNo}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) AS total, SUM(CASE WHEN TASK_STATUS = 'PEND-003' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS completed, SUM(CASE WHEN TASK_STATUS = 'PEND-002' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS inProgress, SUM(CASE WHEN TASK_STATUS = 'PEND-001' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS todo, SUM(CASE WHEN DUE_DATE <= #{today} AND TASK_STATUS != 'PEND-003' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS overdue, CASE WHEN COUNT(*) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND( (SUM(CASE WHEN TASK_STATUS = 'PEND-003' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0) / COUNT(*), 1) END AS completionRate FROM PRJ_TASK WHERE PRJ_NO = #{prjNo}
